name: Mountain run hill repeats 6x3
description: Six steep three-minute uphill efforts with easy recoveries: the core session for uphill mountain running. Needs the console in running mode and --running-mode.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy jog or brisk walk, relaxed shoulders.

steps.name: Hill repeat
steps.notes: RPE 8. Drive the knees and arms, stay tall.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Walk it off; let the breathing settle.
